name: MochaHost
tagline: cPanel shared, reseller and VPS hosting with free migrations and Windows options
description: MochaHost is a US-based cPanel hosting provider offering shared, reseller and VPS plans with free migrations, NVMe storage and optional Windows hosting.
about: MochaHost runs cPanel-based shared hosting in four tiers: Soho (single site, 30GB NVMe SSD storage), Business (unlimited sites, 50GB), Mocha (100GB plus extra CPU/RAM resources), and Ultimate (unlimited storage and bandwidth with the highest resource allocation). All tiers include unlimited bandwidth, free SSL certificates and weekly backups, with the top tiers adding a free domain and daily premium backups. Beyond shared hosting, MochaHost also offers reseller hosting and VPS plans, with the option to run either Linux or Windows Server as the underlying OS — useful for sites built on ASP.NET rather than PHP.

Entry-level Soho pricing starts in the roughly $3-4/month range on a one-year prepaid term. As with most budget hosts, the renewal rate is meaningfully higher than the intro price — some plans have been reported to jump to around $12-13/month after the first term, so it's worth checking the exact renewal figure shown at checkout for your chosen term length before committing. MochaHost also advertises free, unlimited website migrations handled by its team, which is a genuine cost saver versus hosts that charge for transferring an existing site.

MochaHost markets a 'lifetime' price-lock angle on some of its plans, meaning the rate you sign up at is held for as long as you stay subscribed without the usual re-signup discount games — this is a price guarantee, not a fully free hosting tier, so don't confuse it with free-forever hosting.
policies: MochaHost states a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked, on plans of one year or longer. Shorter monthly terms may not carry the same refund window, so confirm the exact terms for your billing cycle before purchasing.

Refunds are typically processed back to the original payment method; setup fees, domain registration costs and any third-party add-ons are commonly excluded from hosting refunds industry-wide — check MochaHost's current terms page for the specifics that apply to your plan.
